messages:
maria: Need a compact launch "playbook" for website + social posts + webinar + inbound routing. Must map CTAs clearly to Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Keep copy tight.

jake: I can draft the hero + three micro-cards and 3 kickoff posts. Prefer: hero = single line, subhead = 2 benefits, then cards per mode with one-line clarifiers.

elsa: I'll pull sanitized metrics: median token latency for hosted, throughput for dedicated, and security callout for private. Can do two short engineering quotes.

ryan: Webinar structure: 25m demo + 10m live Q&A. Panel: Product (maria), Eng (elsa), Customer (ask Glint), Sales Ops (sam). Demo should show smart routing + fallback and Dedicated onboarding steps.

maria: CTA mapping: Hosted -> "Start free API trial"; Dedicated -> "Request reserved capacity"; Private -> "Contact sales for private deploy". Each CTA must wire to a different form/flow.

olivia: For inbound routing: add hidden fields on all forms: deployment_mode, interest_level, region. Example store string: "deployment_mode=private;interest=enterprise;region=EU". That enables SDR rules.

jake: Enums proposal: deployment_mode=[hosted,dedicated,private]; interest_level=[eval,prod,enterprise]; region=[NA,EU,APAC]. I'll reflect these in the copy and form behaviours.

elsa: Draft benchmark blurbs (public-safe): "Hosted: ~80-90ms median token latency; Dedicated: reserved pools delivering stable high throughput; Private: VPC + KMS/HSM options for compliance."

maria: Add a tiny prompt cookbook on each mode page (2 examples each). Keep examples copy/paste-ready and show typical latency/cost expectations in one line below each.

ryan: Routing mapping (ops): if deployment_mode==private => route to team-enterprise@; dedicated => dedicated-sales@; hosted => trial-nurture@. Also include region tag for EMEA/APAC queueing.

sam: I'll prep customer blurb + sign-off if Glint confirms. Could also offer a short case gif for the landing.

maria: Owners & deadlines: Jake = landing hero + 3 posts by Monday; Elsa = metrics + 2 eng quotes by EOD Wed; Olivia = form fields + routing rules by Thurs; Ryan = finalize panel questions + confirm ops routing; Sam = customer asset chase.

jake: I'll drop initial drafts in #copy-ops and link here when live. :thumbsup:

mkt-bot: Reminder: webinar slot reserved Fri 10am PT. Calendar invite sent to panelists.
